1.title: Gunman Acted Alone in Idaho In-N-Out Attack, Authorities Say
1.summary: An off-duty state trooper and private citizen returned fire and are credited with slowing the 24-year-old shooter.

2.title: New Round of Trump Threats and Pullbacks Raises Uncertainty in Mideast
2.summary: Analysts and lawmakers are trying to divine whether Mr. Trump’s latest announcement means negotiations with Iran will truly get underway Monday or if the president is just working through unappealing options.

3.title: Trump suggests new talks with Iran to begin on Monday
3.summary: Tehran has not responded to the suggestion that new talks are imminent. Trump has previously said a negotiated end to the war is close, only for strikes to resume.

4.title: Two crew killed after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece, as British pilot survives
4.summary: One Danish and one Greek national died in the incident, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.

5.title: In Ceuta, Far-Right Leaders Call on Spain to Expel Migrants
5.summary: Far-right politicians and activists are flocking to the Spanish territory on the northern coast of Africa, fueling tensions there days after thousands of migrants entered the exclave.

6.title: Canada’s WestJet Cancels Trips Amid Strike By Flight Attendants
6.summary: Labor talks resumed on Sunday between the airline and union representing 4,400 flight attendants, who want improved wages and compensation for unpaid work.
